description: I am looking at a small new office with one exit. Someone said small offices can do that without a variance. I do not have measured plans or an occupancy calculation yet. Can we start with what you need to know?
known_facts: no measured plans or occupant-load calculation

missing_info.field: building height, building area and floor areas
missing_info.why: Determine applicable Part and the relevant single-exit size limits.

missing_info.field: occupant load served by the exit, sprinkler coverage and travel distances
missing_info.why: These decide whether a single exit is already permitted.

gold.engineering_reason: Storeys, building area and occupancy details are needed to evaluate the Division C business-occupancy exemption.

authoring.notes: Independent synthetic case seeded from Div B 3.4.2.1.(2), NBC(AE) 2023, 2nd printing, PDF p.269. Section C copied from codedb.lookup with explicit db_path. Model-checked; no human professional review or held-out consultation.
